confirmation_lost_on_restart.why: POST /chat/{id}/confirm (or record_decision) with a token another server process minted: approval cards live in memory only, so the card was lost with the restart and nothing ran; 410, hint 'ask again' (LC48D-APPROVAL-1).

switch_in_progress.why: start_workflow while a workflow is active on the session, or start_task for another plan while the session's task runs (status running or waiting_job): 409 naming the active one (kind, id, step or title/status); end_workflow, or waiting for or cancelling the task, comes first (LC48D-GOAL-1).
